stringUnit.value: This image will replace the current cover once the new version passes review. Only players who have joined that version can see it.
新版本审核通过后，此图片将替换当前封面，仅报名该版本的玩家可见。
This cover is part of the approved version. Only players who have joined can see it; the link isn't public.
此封面已包含在通过审核的版本中，仅已报名的玩家可见，链接不对外公开。
